caveats: IRC’s GIS unit created this database to allow for a more sustained approach to producing relevant mapping products and geospatial analysis for regions undergoing emergencies, and will fill gaps in information sharing and management between different UN organizations and  INGOs and other implementing partners during emergency response. IRC’s GIS services provide Woreda base  information and analysis required to monitor the evolution of project / program results and to track project and program impacts across implementing agencies and geographic locations. This dataset contains boundaries of Ethiopian administrative Woredas which are roughly consistent with the actual administrative boundaries for the year 2017.The Woreda boundary contains attribute data (Daro Lebu Woreda of Oromia Region based on the survey conducted January 2019.)
